differential.name: Medication‑induced hypoglycemia (e.g., insulin or sulfonylurea excess with reduced renal clearance)
differential.rationale: Low serum glucose in a dialysis‑dependent diabetic, renal failure impairs insulin clearance.

differential.name: Malnutrition / inadequate oral intake in an elderly CKD patient
differential.rationale: Albumin 3.6 g/dL and weight loss pre‑dialysis suggest poor nutrition contributing to hypoglycemia.

differential.name: Sepsis or acute infection with increased glucose utilization
differential.rationale: Elderly, socially isolated, and immunocompromised (CKD, diabetes) patients are prone to occult infection causing low glucose.

differential.name: Primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison disease)
differential.rationale: Can present with hypoglycemia, especially in the setting of chronic stress and electrolyte abnormalities.

differential.name: Hepatic dysfunction leading to impaired gluconeogenesis
differential.rationale: Although LFTs are near normal, subtle liver disease in a multimorbid patient can contribute to low glucose.
